title: Page 4
content_zh:
徐夫人平日行事很是谨慎，难得有这般“仗势欺人”的时候，她牵着莲姐儿就往二门里走。
童夫人咬咬牙，吩咐刘良安排人赶紧往里抬东西。
春晖园在童府的东北角，离正门不算近，但童府不过三进，远也远不到哪里去。
众人到了门前，有婆子敲门，倒是很快开了门。
只不过，开门的虎妞蹭了一脸黑灰，显得有些狼狈。
童夫人当即心里咯噔一下。
徐夫人也沉了脸，抢先开口问道：“虎妞，你这是怎么了，你们小姐呢？”
虎妞好似见了亲人，欢喜得差点儿跳起来，嚷道：“夫人，您终于来了，您再不来，我和小姐就要饿死了。昨晚和今早都没人来送饭，我在廊檐下掏了个鸟窝，正烧火想要烤鸟给我们小姐吃呢。”
说着话儿，她就让开门，众人一眼望去，果然院子中正点了一些枯草和树枝，烧得很是火红，火堆上架了个小儿拳头大小的乌黑之物。
虎妞还在嚷嚷，“夫人，您是来看小姐的吗？那您带细盐了没？没有咸味不好吃。”
徐夫人转身望向童夫人，嘲讽一笑，“妹妹，平日偶尔碰到，见你穿戴也不差，这家里拾掇得也不错，二小姐更是在最好的女学读书，没想到，家里只是多了两口人，就吃不上饭了。你这脾气也太要强了，但凡昨日说一声，我们也能留下几两银子，不至于把刚回家的孩子饿死。这要是传扬出去，以后别说你了，连我都没脸在外行走了。”
说罢，徐夫人抬脚走了进去，留下童夫人脸上像是被人正反抽了几十下一般，涨红得几乎要爆血管了。
其实她昨日没吩咐春晖园的饮食，也是有意给继女一个下马威，但昨晚睡得晚，早起有些糊涂，也就没想到徐家会这么早上门，就会被徐家抓到了这样的大把柄！
“王姊姊，都是我疏忽了，昨日想起过世的婆母，不禁又病了一场，这才忘了多叮嘱两句。”
她急于解释，可惜徐夫人却是不想听。
莲姐儿更是满院子在喊，“悠悠姊姊，我来了，你在哪里，我给你带点心来了！”
童悠悠从屋里出来，手上拎了一件湿淋淋的衣衫，显见是在洗衣，看得众人又是神色精彩至极。
“悠悠，你这是在做什么？童家就算没有多余的奴仆分来伺候你，我们徐家总能送来几个，你何苦自己做这样的粗活？”徐夫人这几人同悠悠处得好，又谢谢她给自己带来希望，真是把悠悠当亲侄女看待了。
这会儿，她直接红了眼圈，说话也就难听很多，“童家就算不要你，你不会给我送信吗，你义母也罢，我也好，谁不能照顾你吃喝穿戴？堂堂童家大小姐，娇生惯养长大，怎么就要吃烤野鸟，自己洗衣！”
童夫人气得要吐血，万分后悔没有先派人来安顿好，今日这脸是丢定了。

倒是童芊芊一路跟过来，先前还考虑到徐夫人的身分，没敢插嘴，这会儿可是忍不住了。她不敢骂徐夫人，却是不怕童悠悠，高声嚷道：“童悠悠，你是不是故意的？家里每日倒出去的剩饭菜都有几桶，怎么就会差你一口吃的，你分明是故意的！我娘不是你亲娘，你也不能这么陷害她！
“早知道你这么不孝顺，你还不如死在外边，回来干什么！你不知道被多少山贼睡过了……”
“住嘴！”童夫人本想藉着女儿的嘴出口气，没想到童芊芊越说越不象样，她赶紧开口拦阻，末了红着眼同徐夫人道歉，“王姊姊，都是我照顾不周，不怪悠悠生气，摆下这样的架势。芊芊也是心疼我，一时没了规矩……”
这是直接扣了童悠悠一顶陷害继母的帽子，真是做贼喊捉贼！
徐夫人不等她说完，就道：“哦，这么说真是委屈你了。可是，若是这般，那这院子里的奴仆呢，难道都藏了起来？还有早饭呢，也被藏了起来？悠悠可真厉害，刚回府里就能比你这个主母更有威势，让奴仆全为她所用。”
童夫人被堵得不知道说什么好。
徐夫人又望向童芊芊，问道：“二小姐读的女学是芳华院吧？我倒是不知道芳华院除了教授琴棋书画，居然还教授些别的。二小姐连‘睡觉’这样的事都如此熟悉，想必平日言听很多。我们莲姐儿以后择选女学，怕是不能去芳华院了，女孩子还是规矩一些的好。”
若说方才在门口像被搧了几十个巴掌，那么这会儿，童夫人就是结结实实被扎了七八刀子。
方才的话若传了出去，别说童芊芊能不能在芳华院继续读书，怕是以后婆家都找不到了！
童夫人赶紧示意身后的婆子把童芊芊拉下去，然后弯腰行了大礼，一迭声的讨饶，“王姊姊，不，徐夫人，我错了，都是我没有管好奴仆，也没有教导好闺女，求您看在悠悠的脸面上，把方才的事忘了吧。我以后一定尽心尽力照顾悠悠，绝对不会再怠慢半分。”
到底在童家地盘，徐夫人也不好太过，替童悠悠出了一口恶气就作罢。
她伸手扶起童夫人，笑道：“妹妹这是做什么，好似姊姊这客人喧宾夺主一般。我也不过是多嘴说了几句，悠悠好比我亲闺女一般，以后还要妹妹多费心。不过，你是当家主母，怕是也不好整日为这些小事费心。
“正好，我家老嫂子在家惦记悠悠，特意把身边两个得力人手让我带了过来。一个是柳嫂子，擅长台州那边的厨活，以后负责悠悠的一日三餐；一个是她的女儿叫秀红，无论是针线还是洗涮，都极俐落勤快。她们的月银由我们府里管了，但吃喝怕还要妹妹多费一点儿米粮了。”
说罢，她就喊了身后的一个中年妇人和一个十三四岁的姑娘上前行礼。
两人极规矩，半垂着头，行完礼。
之后，柳嫂子就转身去招呼抬箱子的小厮笑道：“原本奴婢还犹豫着要不要带些零碎东西，没想到这些调料和碗盘还真用到了，奴婢这就下厨做顿地道的台州早饭，给主子们尝个新鲜。”
就是秀红也赶紧上前，接了童悠悠手里的湿衣衫。
徐夫人笑得更是欢喜，主动搀扶童夫人的手，“走啊，妹妹一起进屋，我们一起看看悠悠这里还缺什么。你也替她清点一下这些箱子里的东西，虽说是给悠悠的，到底是外边送来的，你这个主母可不能不过眼啊。”
童夫人心里恨得很，到底也想知道箱子里是什么东西，就僵笑着进了屋子。
众人落坐，莲姐儿亲亲热热抱了童悠悠的胳膊，非要同她坐在一处。

童悠悠就摘了腰上的荷包给她玩耍，荷包里装了一套拇指大小的套娃，香木雕琢，居然套了六层，一个比一个精巧，哄得莲姐儿眉开眼笑。
那边，小厮们已经陆续抬了箱子进来。
十车东西里，一车是灶间的米粮干货和各色调料用物，三车是各色屏风、衣架，甚至是梳妆台、桌椅和盆桶之类，都是清一色的黄花梨木，雕花精致，看着就贵气至极。
因为有些物件太大、太多，只能放在院子里，其余能抬进屋中的，也就剩了六车，大大小小六十多箱子。
这些东西流水一般在众人面前
其中，一年四季衣衫就装了满满八箱子，各色绣鞋和冬日的鹿皮靴子、羊皮靴子又占了两箱子，另外还有各色绸缎布料十二箱子。
content_en:
Mrs. Xu usually acted very cautiously. It was rare for her to "use her power to bully others", so she led Sister Lian and walked towards the second door.
Mrs. Tong gritted her teeth and ordered Liu Liang to arrange for someone to carry things inside quickly.
Chunhui Garden is in the northeast corner of the Tong Mansion, not too close to the main entrance, but the Tong Mansion is only three steps in, so it's not that far away.
When everyone arrived at the door, a woman knocked on the door, but she quickly opened the door.
However, the tiger girl who opened the door had a black face and looked a little embarrassed.
Mrs. Tong's heart suddenly skipped a beat.
Mrs. Xu's face also darkened, and she asked first, "Huniu, what's wrong with you, where is your lady?"
Huniu seemed to have met her relatives. She was so happy that she almost jumped up and shouted: "Madam, you are finally here. If you don't come, the lady and I will starve to death. No one came to deliver food last night or this morning. I dug a bird's nest under the eaves and am lighting a fire to roast the bird for our lady to eat."
As she spoke, she opened the door, and everyone took a look. Sure enough, some dead grass and branches were lit in the yard, which burned very red. There was a black thing the size of a child's fist placed on the fire.
Huniu was still shouting, "Madam, are you here to see the lady? Did you bring fine salt? It won't taste good without salt."
Mrs. Xu turned to look at Mrs. Tong and smiled sarcastically, "Sister, I meet you occasionally and see that you are well dressed. The house is also well-organized. The second young lady is studying in the best girls' school. Unexpectedly, there are only two more people in the house. There is no food left. You are too angry. If you say something yesterday, we can save a few taels of money, so that the children who have just returned home will not starve to death. If this spreads, don't talk about you anymore, and I will not be able to walk out. "
After that, Mrs. Xu walked in, leaving Mrs. Tong's face as red as if someone had slapped her dozens of times from the front and back, and her blood vessels were almost bursting.
In fact, she didn't order Chunhuiyuan's food and drink yesterday, and she also intended to give her stepdaughter a showdown. But she went to bed late last night and was a little confused when she got up early. She didn't expect that the Xu family would come home so early, and the Xu family would catch such a big deal!
"Sister Wang, it's all my negligence. I thought of my mother-in-law who passed away yesterday and couldn't help but fell ill again. That's why I forgot to give you a few more words."
She was eager to explain, but unfortunately Mrs. Xu didn't want to listen.
Sister Lian even shouted throughout the courtyard, "Sister Youyou, I'm here. Where are you? I've brought you some snacks!"
Tong Youyou came out of the house, carrying a wet clothes in her hand. It was obvious that she was doing laundry, and everyone looked at her with extremely excited expressions.
"Yuyou, what are you doing? Even if the Tong family doesn't have any extra slaves to serve you, our Xu family can always send a few. Why do you bother to do such menial work yourself?" Mrs. Xu and others got along well with Yuyou, and thanked her for bringing hope to herself. She really treated Youyou as her own niece.
At this moment, her eyes were red, and her words became much more unpleasant, "Even if the Tong family doesn't want you, won't you send me a message? Who can't take care of your food, drink, and clothes, your adoptive mother, or me? The eldest daughter of the Tong family, you have been raised pampered, why do you have to eat roasted wild birds and do your own laundry!"
Mrs. Tong was so angry that she wanted to vomit blood. She regretted not sending someone to settle things first. She would definitely be in disgrace today.
Tong Qianqian, on the other hand, followed all the way. He had previously considered Mrs. Xu's status and didn't dare to interrupt, but now she couldn't help it. She didn't dare to scold Mrs. Xu, but she was not afraid of Tong Youyou. She shouted loudly: "Tong Youyou, did you do it on purpose? There are several buckets of leftovers dumped out every day at home, how could you miss a bite? You clearly did it on purpose! My mother is not your biological mother, and you can't frame her like this!
"If I had known you were so unfilial, you might as well have died outside, why are you coming back! You don’t know how many bandits you’ve slept with…”
"Shut up! "Mrs. Tong wanted to use her daughter's words to express her anger, but she didn't expect that Tong Qianqian became more and more angry as she spoke.It was inappropriate, so she quickly tried to stop her, and finally apologized to Mrs. Xu with red eyes, "Sister Wang, it's all my fault for not taking good care of me. I don't blame Youyou for being angry and acting like this. Qianqian also felt sorry for me, and she lost her rules for a while..."
This directly slaps Tong Youyou on the label of framing her stepmother. It’s really like being a thief and saying “catch the thief!”
Mrs. Xu didn't wait for her to finish speaking, and said, "Oh, I'm really wronging you to say that. But if that's the case, then what about the slaves in this yard? Are they all hidden? And breakfast is also hidden? Youyou is so powerful. Just after returning to the house, she is more powerful than you, the mistress, and makes all the slaves at her disposal."
Mrs. Tong was so blocked that she didn't know what to say.
Mrs. Xu looked at Tong Qianqian again and asked: "The girls' school that the second lady goes to is the Fanghua Academy, right? I didn't know that the Fanghua Academy actually teaches other things besides teaching piano, chess, calligraphy and painting. The second lady is so familiar with things like 'sleeping', so she must have heard a lot about it. We, Sister Lian, will not be able to go to the Fanghua Academy if we choose to go to a girls' school in the future. It's better for girls to behave themselves."
If it was like being slapped dozens of times at the door just now, then now Mrs. Tong was stabbed with seven or eight knives.
If the words just now spread, let alone whether Tong Qianqian can continue studying in Fanghuayuan, I am afraid that her husband's family will not be able to find her in the future!
Mrs. Tong quickly signaled the mother-in-law behind her to pull Tong Qianqian down, then bent down to salute, and begged for mercy repeatedly, "Sister Wang, no, Mrs. Xu, I was wrong. It was me who failed to take care of my servants and teach my daughter well. Please, for the sake of Youyou's face, forget what happened just now. I will do my best to take care of Youyou in the future, and I will never neglect you again."
After all, in the Tong family's territory, Mrs. Xu didn't want to go too far, so she let out a bad breath for Tong Youyou and then gave up.
She stretched out her hand to help Mrs. Tong and said with a smile: "What are you doing, sister? It's like your sister is the guest taking over the guest. I just said a few words. Youyou is like my own daughter, and I want my sister to worry more about it in the future. However, you are the matron of the house, so I'm afraid you can't worry about these little things all day long."
"It just so happened that my old sister-in-law was thinking about Youyou at home, so she specially brought two capable people around her to me. One is sister-in-law Liu, who is good at cooking in Taizhou, and will be responsible for Youyou's three meals a day; the other is her daughter named Xiuhong, who is very neat and diligent in sewing and washing. Their money is managed by our government, but I'm afraid my sister will have to spend a little more on rice to eat and drink. "
After saying that, she called a middle-aged woman and a girl of thirteen or fourteen years old behind her to come forward and salute.
The two of them were very well-behaved, with their heads half bowed, as they finished their salute.
After that, Sister-in-law Liu turned around and greeted the boy carrying the box and said with a smile: "Originally, I was hesitant to bring some odds and ends, but I didn't expect that these condiments and bowls were actually used. I will cook an authentic Taizhou breakfast now to give the masters a fresh taste. "
Even Xiuhong hurried forward and took the wet clothes from Tong Youyou's hand.
Mrs. Xu smiled even more happily, and took the initiative to support Mrs. Tong's hand, "Come on, sister, come into the house together, let's see what is missing here. You should also check the contents of these boxes for her. Although they are for Youyou, they are sent from outside. You, the mistress, must not be conceited. "
Mrs. Tong was filled with hatred. She also wanted to know what was in the box, so she entered the room with a stiff smile.
Everyone sat down, Sister Lian hugged Tong Youyou's arm affectionately, and insisted on sitting with her.
Tong Youyou took off the purse on her waist and gave it to her to play with. There was a set of thumb-sized nesting dolls in the purse. They were carved from fragrant wood and had six layers. Each one was more exquisite than the last, which made Sister Lian smile.
Over there, the boys have already carried boxes in one after another.
Among the ten carts, one cart contained rice, dry goods and various seasoning supplies for the kitchen, and the other three carts contained screens of various colors., clothes racks, and even dressing tables, tables, chairs, basins and buckets are all made of huanghuali wood with exquisite carvings, which makes them look extremely noble.
Because some items were too big and too many, they could only be placed in the yard. The rest could be carried into the house, with only six carts and more than sixty boxes of various sizes left.
These things usually flow in front of everyone
Among them, there are eight full boxes of clothes for all seasons, two boxes of embroidered shoes of various colors, deerskin boots and sheepskin boots for winter, and twelve boxes of silks and satins of various colors.
